book.title: WAI PII EPE MAKEME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Jone Kaimbu Pingi Dokome Pii Lamaiyamo Doko
Gote Ikiningi Jisasa Kraisanya wai pii epe doko tee piamo doko.
Propeta dupame pepa piami dokonya dapa lao pepa pyapae silyamo: “Salapape! Nambanya wai akali doko nambame wambao pena latopa, embanya kaitini doko depa lakata.
Akali doko endakali napalenge yuu mendenya katapala wii lao, ‘Kamongonya kaitini doko depa lakamaiyepape. Kaitini koeyapae dupa tolasakamaiyepape’ lao katatana” lapae singi.
Dopa lapae singili pyoo, Jone kaimbu pingi doko endakali napalenge yuu mendenya katapala, endakali dupanya koo dupa Goteme kunao nepekena, mona kapilyina lao lamaitala, kaimbu pyakamaiyoo katea.

Dokopa Judia yuu doko pitakanya tangepi, Jerusalema tangepi, dupa pitaka baa katea dokonya peami. Pupala dupanya koo dupa lao panata piaminopa, baame endaki Jodane dokonya dupa kaimbu pyata pyakamaiya.
Jone baa yonge pee kamele itimi wasepaepi, matapu kao yanungimi wasepaepi, dupa pyoo katea. Baa paiyombapi, oni kakasa lyingipi, dupa nao katea.
Baame endakali dupa lamaiyoo, “Akali mende nambanya maitanya epelyamo dokonya kyeto dokome namba ita minilyamo. Namba luma lakapala, baanya moko pee dolaponya kende tata lakamaiyanya, namba epe daa.
Nambame nyakama endakimi kaimbu pyekelyo. Dopaka doko, baame Oli Spiritame nyakama kaimbu pyakatana” lea.
Jisasa Kaimbu Nyiamo Doko
Gii dosa mendasa, Jisasa baa yuu Galali dokonya taono Nasarete katao epeamopa, endaki Jodane dokonya Joneme baa kaimbu pyakamaiya.
Baa kaimbu nyepala, endaki ketae pyakalyulu petala kandeamopa, kaiti doko saa papa laloo petala, Spirita doko yaka maiyolee joo lanao ipao baa-kisa petea.
Dokopa kaiti-kisa katao pii mende lea dokome lao pituu, “Emba nambanya Ikiningi mona setenge, nambame etete auu kaenge dokona” lea.
Sataneme Jisasa Makande Piamo Doko
Dopa lalu piamopa, Spirita dokome Jisasa baa endakali napalenge yuu mendenya pena lao pyasia.
Pyaseteamopa baa pupala, endakali napalenge yuu, mena yanapi kapu katenge dokonya, yuu gii 40 katea. Katea gii dutupanya Sataneme baa makande pia. Dokopa enjele dupa ipupala Jisasa nisiami.
Jisasanya Kalai Tee Piamo Doko
Jone kaimbu pingi doko anjeteaminopa, Jisasa baa Galali pupala, Gotenya kingdom dokonya lao wai pii epe doko lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Goteme gii setea doko indupa ipao palipilyamo. Gotenya kingdom doko tengesa ipatelyamona, nyakama mona kapilyetala, wai pii epe doko kiningina lao masalapape”

content: lao katea.
Akali Pisa Nyingi Kitomende Wii Lao Nyiamo Doko
Jisasa baa Galali pete lemba dokonya pupala kandeamopa, Saimonepa, baanya kaiminingi Andruapa, dolapo pisa nyingimba dokonyana, umbene mende endaki pete dokonya pyandao pisa nyoo kateambi.
Dokopa Jisasame dolapo lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nyakambame pisa nyingimbali pyoo, endakali nyalapale mana langitoo, namba watao ipupa”

content: lea.
Dopa lalu piamopa, akali dolapome umbene dupa yakinatala, baa watao peambi.
Umbisale pupala, Jisasame Sebedi ikiningi Jemesapa, kaiminingi Jonepa dolapo sipi andaka umbene tambuu peteambino kandea.
Kanju petala baame dolapo wii lao nyia. Dokopa dolaponya takange Sebedi kalai akali dupa-pipa sipi dokonya yakinatala, dolapo Jisasa watao peambi.
Imambu Koo Mende Watao Piamo Doko
Jisasa baa akali dutupa-pipa Kapename peami. Pupala Sambata gii dokonya lotuu anda dokonya kolandatala, Jisasame mana lea.
Baame mana lea dupa, Mosesanya loo mana nyepae dupame lengemali pyoo laa naenya, baa-kisa mana lapenge kyeto doko singi joo leamosa, endakali dupame sepala paka kaeyao walu leami.
Dokopa akali imambu koo paleta mende lotuu andaka dokonya petea dokome wii lao,
“Nasarete tange Jisasa, embame naima yakinatala puu. Emba Akali Gotenya Latae doko nambame kandengena, embame naima aipa pyaa epe? Naima koeyasala epepe?” lea.
Dokopa Jisasame baa pyalanya lao,

content.text: “Embanya nenge-kaita lyokatala, akali dake yakinatala puu”

content: lea.
Dopa leamopa, imambu koo dokome akali doko minao walu lasetala, ae andake mende lao akali doko yakinatala pea.

Dokopa endakali dupa pitaka paka kaeyao walu latala, mende tipa pii-pii pyoo, “Dake aipa pilya? Mana enenge dake mana aipale mende? Baanya kyeto dokome, imambu koo dupame apata mende pina lelyamopa, lelyali pingima-lamona” leami.
Dokopa Galali makisa yuu singi dupa pitakanya Jisasanya lao pii doko pupae lao, lao taeyami.
Yaina Pyapae Longo Mee Jakamaiyamo Doko
Jisasapi, Jemesapi, Jonepi dutupa lotuu anda doko yakinalu petala, Saimonepa, Andruapanya andaka peami.
Pao pyakamalu piaminopa, Saimonenya enda imange doko yonge itaita pimupa yaina silyamona lao Jisasa lamaiyami.
Lamaitiaminopa, Jisasa enda doko sia dokonya pupala, enda dokonya kinginya minatala baa sakatasia. Dokopa yonge itaita pia doko mee julu piamopa, enda dokome dokaita nee nyoo maiya.
Niki landa pyatala yuu kuiyalanya piamopa, endakali mendapuame yaina pyapaepi, imambu koo paletapi, dupa laminao baa katea dokonya epeami.
Endakali siti dokonya tange dupa pitaka anda kambu dokonya kambu piami.

Dokopa yaina tata waka-wakame pyapae endakali longo dupa baame mee jeta, imambu koo longo dupa watao pyata pyakamaiya. Imambu koo dupame baa akali dokona lao kandengema dokonyana, dupame pii laa naena lao baame daa lea.
Galali Yuu Dokonya Pii Lamaiyamo Doko
Yuu ene yongalanya iminjetae kateamopa, Jisasa sakatao endakali napalenge yuu mendenya pupala, dokonya loma soo katea.
Dokopa Saimonepi, endakali baa-pipa kateamipi, dupame baa kutao peami.
Pao kandatala dupame baa lamaiyoo, “Endakali dupa pitakame emba kutilyaminona” leami.
Dopa leaminopa Jisasame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nambame endakali dupa pitaka wai pii epe doko lamaipenge. Tenge dokonyaka namba epeona, taono yakane tengesa silyamo dupanya apata pii lamaitoo mua”

content: lea.
Dopa latala baame Galali yuu doko pitakanya paeyao, dokaitanya lotuu anda dupanya pii lamaita, imambu koo dupa watao pyata pyakamaiya.
Akali Mendenya Kopetali Mee Jakamaiyamo Doko

Akali kopetali mendeme Jisasa katea dosa ipao luma lakapala, kyeto joo tee lao, “Embame nambanya yaina dake mee jetala, pyoo wasepae kalyale lao maseteno doko, yaina dake mee jakatenopa, namba pyoo wasepae kalyapona” lea.
Dokopa Jisasame akali doko kondo kaeyapala, kingimi watandatala baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Emba pyoo wasepae kalyale lao masetala, nambame embanya yaina doko mee jina lelyona”

content: lea.
Dopa lalu piamopa, kopetali yaina dokome akali doko yakinea. Yakinateamopa baa pyoo wasepae katea.
Dokopa akali dokome dapa nalena lao Jisasame kyeto joo lamaitala baa pena lalu pia:

content.text: “Nambame embanya pyakalo doko endakali mende lamaiya naenya, prisa dokome emba kandena puu. Pupala Mosesame mana seteali pyoo embame dopale mende Gote kundi maitinopa, endakali dupame emba pyoo wasepae kalyene-lamo lao kandenana”

content: lea.

Dopa leaka doko akali doko pupala, pia dupa pitaka tee pyao lao taeya. Dopa pia dokonya, Jisasa siti mendenya panao pupenge nanjiamosa, endakali napalenge yuu dupanya katea. Kateamopa, endakali dupa yuu dupa pitakanya katao baa katea dokonya epeami.
